booking.unavailable: This stay can't be booked - it doesn't exist or is no longer available.
booking.payOnStripe: You'll pay {amount} on Stripe's payment page.

booking.tooLate: Check-in is less than {hours} hours away - this booking can't be cancelled online.

booking.pendingNote: Your booking starts as pending until the host confirms it. You won't be charged now.
booking.estimateServer: Estimate - the final price is calculated by the server when you confirm.
booking.justBooked: These dates were just booked by someone else. Please pick different dates.
booking.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

refund.arranging: Full refund of {amount} - the host is arranging your refund.

myBookings.processing: Payment processing at your bank - your dates stay held.

dialog.title: Cancel this booking?
dialog.willCancel: , {from} – {to} ({nights}, {total}), will be cancelled and the dates released.
dialog.final: This can't be undone - to go back you'd need to book again (if the dates are still free).
dialog.paid: You'll get a full refund of {amount}, back to your card within 5–10 business days.
dialog.open: Your payment page will be closed, and you won't be charged.
dialog.nothing: You haven't been charged, so there's nothing to refund.

reviewDialog.title: Review your stay
reviewDialog.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
reviewDialog.final: Reviews are final: once posted you can't edit or delete it. It shows your first name and last initial.

saved.emptyHint: Tap the heart on any stay to save it here.

paymentReturn.processingLead: Your bank is still processing the payment. Your dates stay held, and your booking is confirmed as soon as it goes through - we'll show it in My bookings.

paymentReturn.unpaidLead: Your dates are held for {remaining} (until {time}). Pay now to confirm your booking - after that the dates are released.
paymentReturn.timedOutLead: The time to pay for booking #{id} has run out, so the dates are being released. You weren't charged.
paymentReturn.declinedLead: Your bank declined the payment, so booking #{id} was cancelled and the dates released. You weren't charged.
paymentReturn.expiredLead: The time to pay for booking #{id} ran out, so it was cancelled and the dates released. You weren't charged.
